author: GetInTheVan
quote: Its just not GTA anymore, visually frame by frame its great, PC release will bring up the FPS, and it will look visual awesome. However, its just isn't GTA…. You'd have to play to even begin to understand… If it were renamed with a different game name, and I wasn’t expecting to play GTA, Id rate it maybe a 4/10, but with the hype of GTA, I was expecting to play GTA, and this just isn't it…
